text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it confirmed all ratings on the Toronto-Dominion Bank with stable trends.

DBRS confirmed the deposits and senior debt of T-D and T-D Mortgage Corp at AA, T-D Bank's subordinate debt at AA (low), its cumulative first preferred shares at Pfd-1, its non-cumulative first preferred shares at Pfd-1 (low) and T-D Bank and T-D Mortgage short-term instruments at R-1 (middle).

"In general terms, the rating continues to reflect the above-average strengths which T-D has in capital and credit quality, which are only partly neutralized by the above-average concentration in Ontario and the fact that although improving, profitability is still lower than some peer banks," the rating agency said.
